issues.issue: Whether the RPD breached procedural fairness in assessing the applicant's documents
issues.applicant_position: RPD breached procedural fairness by not letting him respond to concerns about documents during the hearing.
issues.respondent_position: RPD must consider and weigh evidence in refugee claims.
issues.result_text: No procedural fairness breach; counsel invited review of the documents and applicant cannot be surprised by the review.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD's adverse credibility findings were reasonable
issues.applicant_position: Adverse credibility conclusion was unreasonable and over-zealous; RPD failed to analyse the claim properly.
issues.respondent_position: RPD's statement meant it did not believe the applicant was a Church member.
issues.result_text: Errors in the credibility assessment are significant and require redetermination of the refugee claim.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred by not analysing the s. 97 claim separately
issues.applicant_position: RPD failed to analyse the s. 97 claim separately.
issues.result_text: No error in omitting a separate s. 97 analysis; the credibility finding suffices for both claims.
